entities.name: Pál Lakatos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pál Lakatos is a retired boxer from Hungary, who represented his native country at two Summer Olympics: in 1992 and 2000. He once won the silver medal at the European Championships, in 1993, and thrice captured the bronze medal in the Light Flyweight at the European Championships, in 1991, 1998 and 2000.
